OverrideClient.Name: Override Client Configuration
OverrideClient.Hint: Forces all clients to use the same configuration. REQUIRES RELOAD

WorldActions.Name: Include World Actions
WorldActions.Hint: Include basic actions that have been imported into the world in the action hud.

CompendiumActions.Name: Include Compendium Actions
CompendiumActions.Hint: Include basic actions from the compendium in the action hud.

IncludeSpecial.Name: Include Special Actions Panel
IncludeSpecial.Hint: Include a panel that allows the player to activate special actions. REQUIRES RELOAD

IncludePassTurn.Name: Include Pass Turn Panel
IncludePassTurn.Hint: Include a panel that allows the player to pass their turn during combat. REQUIRES RELOAD

ShowEmpty.Name: Show Empty Panels
ShowEmpty.Hint: Displays action panels when no actions present.

RefreshAll.Name: Refresh All Actions
RefreshAll.Hint: Refreshes all cached actions and compendiums.
RefreshAll.Long: Refreshes all cached compendiums and actions. Useful if you have added or removed actions or compendiums and want to refresh Argon.
